newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LAMA FREED FOR TRANSFER ABROAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LAMA FREED FOR TRANSFER ABROAD.

text.p: Paris St Germain goalkeeper Bernard Lama, who is serving a two-month ban for using cannabis, has been freed by the French Football Federation (FFF) for a transfer to a foreign club.
The FFF notified the French international, who has been linked with Spanish champions Real Madrid, of their decision on Monday.
World soccer body FIFA said at the end of May it would not extend the suspension -- a five-month ban, with three months suspended, handed down in mid-May -- internationally.
Lama, France's Euro 96 goalkeeper, was dropped for the Tournoi de France this month because of the suspension.

He tested positive for cannabis while training with the French national team in February. A second urine sample tested in April was also positive and Lama was suspended last month. He decided against an appeal.
